import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('eu_economic_data.csv')
eu = df[df.Country=='EU_Total']
c = df[df.Country!='EU_Total']

print('=== EU headline ===')
print(eu[['Year','GDP_Growth_Pct','Inflation_Pct','Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR','Public_Debt_Pct_GDP','Unemployment_Pct']].to_string(index=False))

print('\n=== Cumulative growth 2022-24 ===')
g = c.groupby('Country').GDP_Growth_Pct.sum().sort_values()
print(g.round(1).to_string())

print('\n=== Inflation change 22->24 ===')
for cc in c.Country.unique():
    s = c[c.Country==cc].sort_values('Year')
    print(f'{cc:12s} {s.Inflation_Pct.iloc[0]:5.1f} -> {s.Inflation_Pct.iloc[2]:5.1f}  (delta {s.Inflation_Pct.iloc[2]-s.Inflation_Pct.iloc[0]:+.1f})')

print('\n=== Trade balance change 22->24 ===')
for cc in c.Country.unique():
    s = c[c.Country==cc].sort_values('Year')
    print(f'{cc:12s} {s.Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR.iloc[0]:7.1f} -> {s.Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR.iloc[2]:7.1f}  (delta {s.Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR.iloc[2]-s.Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR.iloc[0]:+.1f})')

print('\n=== Debt change 22->24 ===')
for cc in c.Country.unique():
    s = c[c.Country==cc].sort_values('Year')
    print(f'{cc:12s} {s.Public_Debt_Pct_GDP.iloc[0]:6.1f} -> {s.Public_Debt_Pct_GDP.iloc[2]:6.1f}  (delta {s.Public_Debt_Pct_GDP.iloc[2]-s.Public_Debt_Pct_GDP.iloc[0]:+.1f})')

print('\n=== 2024 unemployment ===')
print(c[c.Year==2024][['Country','Unemployment_Pct']].sort_values('Unemployment_Pct').to_string(index=False))

print('\n=== 2024 growth ranking ===')
print(c[c.Year==2024][['Country','GDP_Growth_Pct']].sort_values('GDP_Growth_Pct', ascending=False).to_string(index=False))
EOF
